verdicts.reason: Both move the lime circle off the shoe and leave it as a floating blob at the bottom, cropped by the canvas edge. That breaks the key hero image and leaves a dead lower third. A at least has a clean top stack: logo centred, then badge, then shoe. However, its 'Full review inside.' line runs almost to the right edge, and the gap between the shoe and the headline is loose. B jams the NEW VIDEO pill and a shrunken VOLTSTRIDE logo side by side in the top strip. The logo nearly touches the right edge and the badge competes with the brand, so B's top is cramped and weaker than A's.
